voice.decision: all three preset policies must agree; otherwise uncertain; engineering gates, no calibration
voice.scope: 33 TRAIN speaker WAV files only; no listener access, paid API or GPU
voice.interpretation: estimated number of sustained distinguishable voices, not proof of exact speaker count; brief second voice may be missed

spectral.method: cosine affinity, row top-neighbor pruning, symmetric unnormalized Laplacian, largest eigengap among k=1 and k=2 INCLUDING first eigenvalue
spectral.stable_rule: all three counts equal; if two, partition ARI >= .8; minimum two windows and 2.4s per cluster
spectral.status: exploratory after distance-gate v1 failed on 33/33; not calibrated or accepted weak labels
spectral.role: unknown; anonymous AU and 52-D motion are auxiliary, not identity or speaker-count truth

notes: Frozen pilot methods; counts not calibrated; no media upload or paid API; no ASR rerun, no automatic source identity or semantic-cache changes.
